questions.question_text: Will the cumulative count of patients with a regulatory-approved therapeutic brain-computer interface implant (FDA PMA or international equivalent) reach at least 10,000 worldwide on or before 2032-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if at least two independent public sources (national regulator database plus manufacturer or peer-reviewed registry) corroborate cumulative approved therapeutic BCI implants >= 10,000 through 2032-12-31. FALSE if confirmed count remains below 10,000. VOID if no authoritative count exists by deadline or major jurisdictions withdraw all approvals without replacement.

questions.question_text: Will a fusion power installation deliver at least 100 MW net electrical power to a commercial transmission grid continuously for 30 days on or before 2032-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if operator or national regulator publishes verified net-to-grid >= 100 MW sustained 30 consecutive days by 2032-12-31. FALSE if never achieved. VOID if records are disputed without independent audit or plant never connected to a commercial grid.

questions.question_text: Will a government or private space mission achieve a controlled uncrewed landing on the Martian surface with published telemetry confirmation on or before 2032-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if mission operator and at least one independent space agency acknowledge successful controlled uncrewed surface landing by 2032-12-31. FALSE if no such landing occurs. VOID if landing claim lacks surface telemetry and remains disputed through deadline.

questions.question_text: Will the combined reported daily active users of the three largest consumer AI companion applications worldwide reach at least one billion on any single calendar day on or before 2030-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if credible public filings or audited metrics show top-3 AI companion apps sum DAU >= 1e9 on at least one day by 2030-12-31. FALSE if peak sum remains below 1e9. VOID if fewer than two of the top three publish comparable DAU definitions.

questions.question_text: Will at least three OECD member countries have a national statute or supreme-court-approved framework allowing AI-assisted judicial drafting or sentencing analytics in routine civil or criminal trial courts on or before 2035-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if official legal gazettes or supreme court records document operational AI-assisted court analytics in >=3 OECD members by 2035-12-31. FALSE if fewer than three. VOID if frameworks exist only as pilots without binding court rules.

questions.question_text: Will the U.S. FDA grant traditional or accelerated approval to at least one senolytic or senomorphic drug for an age-related or chronic disease indication on or before 2033-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if FDA approval letter lists senolytic/senomorphic mechanism for an age-related indication by 2033-12-31. FALSE if no such approval. VOID if approval is withdrawn before deadline without successor label.

questions.question_text: Will at least three G7 countries show a statistically significant widening (p<0.05) in a published top-decile versus median healthy-life expectancy or anti-aging therapy access index between 2024 and 2035?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if peer-reviewed or national statistics office publications document significant widening in >=3 G7 countries using consistent methodology. FALSE if fewer than three. VOID if no comparable cross-country index exists.

questions.question_text: Will retail CBDC settlement account for at least 10 percent of total retail payment transaction value in at least five OECD economies on an annual basis on or before 2035-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if central bank or BIS published statistics show >=10% retail payment value via CBDC in >=5 OECD members for any full calendar year ending by 2035. FALSE otherwise. VOID if CBDC metrics are not separately reported.

questions.question_text: Will the G7 plus China and India sign a multilateral treaty or MOU establishing interoperable digital identity credentials for cross-border public services on or before 2040-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if deposited treaty text or official joint communique documents interoperable digital ID standards adopted by G7+China+India by 2040-12-31. FALSE if not signed. VOID if signature occurs without published technical interoperability spec.

questions.question_text: Will at least three hyperscale cloud provider regions each serving more than 5 million active customer workloads experience simultaneous control-plane unavailability exceeding six continuous hours on or before 2045-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if provider postmortems or independent outage trackers confirm >=3 regions with >6h control-plane outage in overlapping 24h window by 2045-12-31. FALSE if never occurs. VOID if outage definitions differ materially across providers without reconciliation.

questions.question_text: Will at least one G7 country enact nationwide legislation prohibiting retail merchants from accepting physical cash for goods and services, with enforcement beginning on or before 2040-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if national legal gazette publishes enforceable retail cash ban with start date <=2040-12-31 in a G7 member. FALSE if no G7 member enacts. VOID if ban is enacted then repealed before enforcement begins.

questions.question_text: Will the FAO Food Price Index monthly nominal value exceed 150 percent of its January 2024 level on any month on or before 2038-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if official FAO FPI release shows any month >150% of Jan-2024 baseline by 2038-12-31. FALSE if peak remains <=150%. VOID if FAO changes index methodology without published back-adjustment.

questions.question_text: Will at least three OECD member states enact nationally enforceable regulation requiring consumer devices sold after a published effective date to include hardware-backed decentralized identity (DID) or secure-element key storage for personal credentials, with enforcement beginning on or before 2035-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if national legal gazettes or regulator rulebooks in >=3 OECD members publish enforceable on-device hardware-backed DID or secure-element credential mandates with effective date <=2035-12-31. FALSE if fewer than three. VOID if mandates exist only as voluntary industry guidelines without statutory or regulator-enforceable penalties.

questions.question_text: Will at least one messaging service with end-to-end encryption enabled by default for all one-to-one and group chats report at least one billion daily active users worldwide on or before 2032-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if operator-published metrics or two independent third-party estimates corroborate >=1e9 DAU on a messaging service with E2EE default for all standard chat modes through 2032-12-31. FALSE if no service meets both conditions. VOID if DAU definitions differ materially without reconciliation or operator stops publishing comparable metrics.

questions.question_text: Will at least five OECD economies each report that at least 50 percent of households with internet access hold at least one active self-custody digital asset wallet (user-controlled private keys not solely custodied by a regulated exchange), according to official survey or regulator statistics, on or before 2038-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if national statistical offices, central banks, or financial regulators in >=5 OECD members publish household surveys showing >=50% of internet-connected households with >=1 active self-custody wallet through 2038-12-31. FALSE if fewer than five meet threshold. VOID if wallet definitions exclude hardware wallets or conflate exchange accounts without key-export rights.

questions.question_text: Will the global count of deployed humanoid or general-purpose service robots in active operation exceed the world human population on any day on or before 2045-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if at least two industry associations or national statistical agencies publish corroborated counts showing operational humanoid/service robots > world population on a single day by 2045-12-31. FALSE if never exceeded. VOID if definitions of deployed/operational differ irreconcilably across sources.

questions.question_text: Will any invasive memory-encoding or memory-write neural interface intervention reach Phase III clinical trial status in a major public trial registry on or before 2048-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if ClinicalTrials.gov or WHO ICTRP lists Phase III for memory-write neural intervention by 2048-12-31. FALSE if none reach Phase III. VOID if trial is halted for safety without successor registration.

questions.question_text: Will an independent audit report certify that at least one general AI system achieves at least 80 percent expert-level success on a published multi-domain AGI evaluation suite on or before 2040-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if audit from accredited lab or consortium documents >=80% expert-level aggregate on named public suite by 2040-12-31. FALSE if not achieved. VOID if suite changes mid-evaluation without frozen protocol hash.

questions.question_text: Will the documented resident population of Mars reach at least one million and will a Mars governing body declare political independence from Earth national sovereignties on or before 2050-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE only if both conditions met by 2050-12-31: population >=1e6 per UN or space-agency endorsed census AND independence declaration recognized by >=2 UN members. FALSE if either condition fails. VOID if population counts remain classified without public audit.

questions.question_text: Will at least five G7-equivalent economies jointly impose a coordinated emergency pause of at least 30 consecutive days on frontier large-model training or public deployment on or before 2042-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if official joint statement plus national enforcement orders document >=30 day coordinated pause by 2042-12-31. FALSE if no such pause. VOID if pause is announced but not enforced in >=3 jurisdictions.

questions.question_text: Will peer-reviewed science document a viable embryo of an extinct mammalian species produced via synthetic or ancient-DNA methods with survival beyond 72 hours ex vivo on or before 2045-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if published in indexed journal with independent replication note and embryo viability >72h by 2045-12-31. FALSE if not demonstrated. VOID if paper retracted for fraud before deadline.

questions.question_text: Will at least five OECD countries report that neural-linked or implant-mediated wallet payments exceed 5 percent of national retail transaction count for any calendar year ending on or before 2048-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if central bank or national payments authority publishes neural/implant-mediated payments >=5% of retail transaction count in >=5 OECD members for any year through 2048. FALSE otherwise. VOID if metric is not separately disclosed.

questions.question_text: Will the United Nations or an equivalent multilateral body deposit a treaty recognizing separate legal personhood tracks for biological humans versus substrate-independent digital persons on or before 2055-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if deposited treaty text defines distinct personhood tracks for biological humans and substrate-independent digital persons by 2055-12-31. FALSE if no such treaty. VOID if treaty is signed but not deposited or lacks operative definitions.

questions.question_text: Will at least three of the five largest national economies by nominal GDP (IMF WEO, 2099 reference year) route a majority of retail and wholesale payment settlement volume through post-2030 greenfield governance stacks that bypass legacy bank-regulator clearing intermediaries, as measured on or before 2100-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if at least three of the top-five 2099 economies publish regulator or central-bank audited statistics showing >50% of domestic payment settlement volume cleared via greenfield protocols (defined as stacks launched after 2030-01-01 without legacy correspondent-bank rails as primary path) through 2100-12-31. FALSE if fewer than three meet the threshold by deadline. VOID if fewer than two top-five economies publish comparable settlement-rail definitions by 2101-03-31 or IMF discontinues comparable GDP ranking.

questions.question_text: Will at least one OECD member health ministry or equivalent national health authority publicly classify aging-related mortality as an engineering defect class with a published remediation SLO target date, and maintain that classification continuously from first publication through 2100-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if an OECD-scale authority publishes an official document labeling aging-related mortality as an engineering or systems defect with a dated remediation SLO, and no subsequent official retraction occurs before 2100-12-31. FALSE if no such publication exists or all such classifications are officially retracted before 2100-12-31. VOID if OECD membership structure changes such that no comparable authority exists, or defect-class terminology cannot be verified from primary sources by 2101-03-31.

questions.question_text: Will fewer than 25% of humans with recognized legal personhood in the five most populous UN member states rely on non-biological primary cognitive substrate (whole-brain emulation, substrate upload, or equivalent) as their primary legal identity substrate, as officially reported on or before 2100-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if aggregated official census or civil-registry statistics from the five most populous states show <25% of legally recognized persons using non-biological primary cognitive substrate through 2100-12-31. FALSE if >=25% in aggregate. VOID if fewer than three of the five publish substrate-classification statistics with comparable definitions by 2101-03-31.

questions.question_text: Will humanity's verified planetary primary energy harness remain below 10^17 watts (order-of-magnitude Kardashev Type I threshold) according to at least two independent global energy balance assessments, as of 2100-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if at least two independent assessments (e.g. IEA successor, peer-reviewed planetary energy budget consortium) report primary energy harness <10^17 W through 2100-12-31. FALSE if two or more independent assessments report >=10^17 W sustained for at least one calendar year ending on or before 2100-12-31. VOID if no two independent assessments publish comparable planetary primary-energy totals by 2101-03-31.
